name: Navbar
looksLike: bar across the top of the page with links
logo on the left and menu links on the right
header with a button on the far right
definition: A horizontal bar at the top of the page holding the logo, the main navigation links, and often a call-to-action button.

notConfusedWith.difference: Slides in on demand; the navbar is always visible.

prompts.short: Add a sticky top navbar: logo left, links center, CTA right.
prompts.detailed: Add a sticky top navbar with the logo on the left, centered nav links with a clear active state, and a primary CTA button on the right. Collapse to a hamburger menu that opens a drawer below 768px, and use a nav landmark with an aria-label.

reactTailwind: <nav aria-label="Main" className="mx-auto flex h-14 max-w-6xl items-center justify-between px-4">
Sign up

a11yNotes: Wrap the links in a nav element with an aria-label
Mark the current page with aria-current
